# Math

Adds, multiplies, compares or rounds numbers — for example to scale opacity with height.

`lfs.math` · Utilities

## How to use

Choose an operation, then connect values to A and B.\
Start with Multiply to scale a selection's strength.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | `A` | lfs.float | 0 | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | First number in the units of your calculation. 0 is the default. |
| B | `B` | lfs.float | 0 | step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Second number in the units of your calculation. 0 is the default. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value | `Value` | lfs.float | — | — | Resulting number, in the units of your calculation. Connect it to a compatible numeric input. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Operation | `operation` | enum | add | add; subtract; multiply; divide; power; minimum; maximum; absolute; sqrt; floor; fraction; sine; cosine; greater_than; less_than; clamp | Calculation to perform. Add is the default; operations such as Absolute use A only. |
